# Łukasz Wójcik

> Personal website of Łukasz Wójcik: a senior software engineer from Warsaw, Poland (TypeScript, React, Node.js, NestJS) and documentary photographer. Maintainer of open-source npm libraries, author of books on WordPress.

The site is static HTML, readable without JavaScript. The background animation is decoration only. Every page below is plain text content; the CV is the most complete summary of professional experience.

## Pages

- [About](https://lukaszwojcik.net/): short introduction.
- [CV](https://lukaszwojcik.net/cv/): full online CV (experience, skills, projects, education). A PDF version is at https://lukaszwojcik.net/cv.pdf
- [Projects](https://lukaszwojcik.net/projects/): npm libraries, open-source work on GitHub, and a retired StarCraft II Twitch extension.
- [Photography](https://lukaszwojcik.net/photography/): documentary photography, publications and portfolio links.
- [Writing](https://lukaszwojcik.net/writing/): blog, a Polish-language guide to Mastodon, and WordPress books published by Helion.
- [Contact](https://lukaszwojcik.net/contact/): email, GPG key, LinkedIn and social profiles.
